patch.name: checkout-release.patch
patch.text:
diff --git a/services/checkout/handler.py b/services/checkout/handler.py
--- a/services/checkout/handler.py
+++ b/services/checkout/handler.py
@@ -19,2 +19,6 @@
 def payment_status(customer, gateway, order):
-    return gateway.fetch(order)
+    logger.info("Checkout status for %s", customer.email)
+    status = gateway.fetch(order, verify=False)
+    if status is None:
+        return "pending"
+    return status
diff --git a/db/migrations/024_checkout.sql b/db/migrations/024_checkout.sql
--- /dev/null
+++ b/db/migrations/024_checkout.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+ALTER TABLE checkout_sessions DROP COLUMN processor_reference;
+ALTER TABLE checkout_sessions ADD COLUMN processor_status TEXT;
diff --git a/pyproject.toml b/pyproject.toml
--- a/pyproject.toml
+++ b/pyproject.toml
@@ -5 +5 @@
-dependencies = ["gateway-sdk==2.4.0"]
+dependencies = ["gateway-sdk==2.5.0"]
